steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Here's how to change a client's details in the ConstructHUB CRM, and what Delete does.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open the client. We'll use Imani Brewster.

steps.caption: Phone
steps.narration: Change what you need. Imani has a new phone number.

steps.caption: Intake notes
steps.narration: Intake notes are for your team only.

steps.caption: Updated
steps.narration: Her page shows the new number and the note straight away.

steps.caption: Delete
steps.narration: Delete removes a client for good. Only the workspace owner sees this button.

steps.caption: Delete asks first
steps.narration: Choose Delete, and the CRM asks you to confirm.

steps.caption: Delete permanently
steps.narration: Imani has work on file. So when you choose Delete permanently, nothing is removed yet.

steps.caption: What would be removed
steps.narration: The CRM counts her estimates, invoices, projects and calendar visits, and asks again.

steps.caption: Delete everything
steps.narration: Delete everything removes all of it, and it cannot be undone.

steps.caption: Cancel
steps.narration: We'll choose Cancel, and Imani stays.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find Clients in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to edit or delete a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of editing a client in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will change a phone number and the intake notes, then see what Delete checks and asks before it removes a client and their work.
